ARPA Funding Overview

  1. The City of Ann Arbor
  2. Finance and Administrative Services
  3. Financial Reporting
  4. ARPA Funding Overview

​​​​​The City of Ann Arbor was awarded $24.2 million in funds under the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA). This page reports on the budgeting of those funds and provides monitoring of their expenditure.​

Overview Dashboard

The city has created a dashboard that provides an overview of how ARPA funds have been budgeted. It includes high-level information about each project and its expenditures to date. The dashboard can be found at the following link: ARPA Funding Dashboard.

Background & Contact

You can learn more about the process of community engagement that led to these project allocations ​by visiting this Systems Planning page. The city can be contacted about ARPA funding at ​​RescueFunds@a2gov.org​ or 734.794.6435.
